moments.title: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean make chart history
moments.blurb: Sam Fender and Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' extends its record-breaking run to 20 weeks at number one on the UK Official Singles Chart, making it the longest-running chart-topper ever.

angles.name: Chart Record
angles.copy: 20 weeks at Number 1! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' just keeps on going, smashing the record for the UK's longest-running chart-topper. What a tune!

angles.name: Fender & Dean
angles.copy: History made! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean are still reigning supreme at #1. Is 'Rein Me In' the greatest record-breaker of all time?

moments.title: Ariana Grande dominates chart and prepares for London tour
moments.blurb: Ariana Grande has two new entries in the Official UK Singles Chart Top 5 with 'Petal' (new at No. 4) and 'hate that i made you love me' (up to No. 3), and kicks off her 'Eternal Sunshine' tour in London this Saturday.

angles.name: Chart & Tour
angles.copy: Ariana Grande is absolutely everywhere! Two tracks in the Top 5 AND her Eternal Sunshine tour hits London this weekend. Who's got tickets?

angles.name: London Gigs
angles.copy: London, get ready! Ariana Grande's Eternal Sunshine Tour begins its 10-night residency at The O2 this Saturday. What a week for Ari fans!

angles.name: TV Must-Watch
